BiblicalUsage: Gachar is one of the Nethinim, the temple servants who returned from exile. The children of Gahar are listed among the returnees in Ezra 2:47 and again in Nehemiah 7:49. The King James spells the name Gahar; his family came home to serve in the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Nethinim are the quiet heroes of the return. They were servants, not priests, yet they came home to serve, and I hold that the lowest service in God's house is honour enough.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
